purpose: Machine-readable contract between DUFYND operating data and Jarvis.

reference_intake.rule: Learn mechanisms from references; do not copy them shot-for-shot.

idea_generation.composition_rule: Prefer 2-5 compatible reusable creative patterns, including a hook and a product reveal or payoff.

identity_rules: Use deterministic DUFYND typography in final branded frames.
Use verified clean product masters for identity-critical readable product frames.
Do not spend generations trying to repair generated label drift.
Affiliate commission never changes fragrance recommendations; among equal-total, comparably fresh affiliate offers it may break a tie.

active_runtime.rule: Active model execution requires explicit operator approval, an active database budget window, an explicit model, and valid credentials. Passive capture remains live while active execution is off. Each event run is bounded by both max turns and max_budget_usd; supervisor mode may process several events under one operator activation but must stop when the inbox is empty, the configured event limit is reached, an event fails, or the active budget/runtime gate refuses another run.

supervisor_mode.approval_scope: one GO-JARVIS-ACTIVE token per bounded supervisor invocation
supervisor_mode.safety: Supervisor mode does not expand the tool surface. Publishing, spending, contracts, production merges and destructive production changes remain unavailable.

control_plane_sync.rule: Refresh derived repository state, upsert the canonical repo snapshot and current domain tasks, then require exact source_fingerprint_sha256 parity before Jarvis may use the autonomy queue.

safe_worker_mode.task_scope: repo_current_* tasks that are safe_to_execute and do not require human approval
safe_worker_mode.task_progress_rule: Safe worker may record non-terminal progress/evidence only; it must not mark a task done automatically.
safe_worker_mode.safety: No repository mutation, shell execution, publishing, spend, contracts, secrets, live catalog routing, or merge/push capability.

branch_worker_mode.task_scope: repo_current_* engineering tasks that are safe_to_execute and do not require human approval
branch_worker_mode.repository_write_scope: local checkout only; deterministic workflow validates allowlisted paths and emits a patch artifact
branch_worker_mode.safety: No push, merge, deployment, publishing, spend, credentials, Supabase migrations, operational data writes, workflows, lockfiles or dependency-manifest changes.

validation.rule: Storefront patches must pass both repository Python checks and deterministic web/visual QA before the patch artifact is accepted.

sequence: defer task execution while inbox backlog remains
route engineering tasks to isolated branch worker
route non-engineering safe tasks to read-only safe worker
validate any branch-worker patch with allowlist, Python checks, and storefront web/visual QA when applicable
autonomous_cycle.financial_rule: The active database budget window remains authoritative. Autonomous mode cannot create, enlarge, reactivate or bypass a budget window.
autonomous_cycle.scheduling: No recurring schedule is enabled by this contract. Scheduling is a separate operator-controlled activation step.
autonomous_cycle.safety: Autonomous-cycle may prepare and validate an isolated repository patch but still cannot push, merge, deploy, publish, spend money, change credentials, mutate live catalog routing, or bypass the active database budget window.

nightshift_orchestrator.resume_rule: Reuse the open session only when the synchronized repo fingerprint is unchanged. Stable task state is preserved for the same fingerprint to avoid duplicate execution after interruption.
nightshift_orchestrator.budget_rule: Check the active database budget window before every paid worker attempt. Nightshift cannot create, reactivate, enlarge or bypass a budget window.
nightshift_orchestrator.branch_rule: At most one engineering patch may await deterministic validation in one checkout; non-engineering GREEN work may continue.
nightshift_orchestrator.yellow_handoff: Validated engineering patches may be pushed only to a jarvis/worker-* branch and opened as a PR against scentai-mvp. They are never auto-merged.
nightshift_orchestrator.morning_report: Generate JSON and Markdown from persisted session state, autonomy queue, health, pending decisions, budget status and audited agent runs.
nightshift_orchestrator.scheduling: No recurring schedule is enabled. The pilot requires an explicit operator-started workflow dispatch.

nightshift_policy.operating_rule: Jarvis consumes work, not time. It must stop when no safe work remains instead of polling or burning model budget.
